crossRefs.note: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you…
For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.
The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From…
Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea, have replenished.
Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly…

people.name: Tarshish
people.line: Distant maritime city known for its wealth and trade

translations.web: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!
translations.bsb: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, O inhabitants of the coastland!
translations.kjv: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
translations.asv: Pass ye over to Tarshish; wail, ye inhabitants of the coast.
